steps.name: Align UI gate contract
steps.description: Align the explicit UI design gate contract across code comments, CLI messages, spec template, design README, and installed skill templates. Keep generic UI/frontend text advisory-only and make opt-in wording explicit.
steps.acceptance: User-facing guidance no longer says generic keywords trigger UI design flow; advisory text says explicit opt-in is required before design evidence matters; references to design five-piece are replaced with UI/UX design evidence package.

steps.name: Enforce stack evidence in check
steps.description: Reuse the existing missingFrameworkDecision gate in check for explicit required UI tasks so closeout catches missing or weak frontend-stack.md even when go is bypassed or historical evidence is incomplete.
steps.acceptance: check fails required UI tasks missing frontend-stack.md and reports actionable remediation without changing exempt/advisory behavior.

steps.name: Add visual acceptance template assets
steps.description: Add templates/design/visual-acceptance.md and update design README, write-design command docs, installed command copies, and design skill templates to treat acceptance as a first-class artifact.
steps.acceptance: visual-acceptance.md template exists in source templates and installed assets reference the same evidence package sequence.

steps.name: Tests and verification
steps.description: Update focused tests for UI gate wording, check frontend-stack enforcement, write-design acceptance support, and install/template coverage; run build and impacted test suites before full check.
steps.acceptance: build:test, focused node tests, pnpm test, docpath check, and docpath review pass.
